ceilingSources.residentMemoryBytes: bounded provisional ceiling of 1 GiB (below the 1400 MiB 2x option) set after LedgerStore::mutate stopped cloning the whole ledger per mutation (#344); to be re-derived by the rule 2x the larger measured resident set, rounded up to a whole MiB, once the bench is recorded on both hosts for the fixed build; evidence runtime-budget.evidence/
ceilingSources.idleCpuPercent: rule: 1 percent absolute for an idle crate; measured at most 0.0 percent on the recorded hosts
ceilingSources.wakeupsPerSecond: rule: max(1, 2x measured) per second; macOS measured 0.033; Windows exposes no wake-up counter
ceilingSources.diskOpsPerSecond: rule: max(1, 2x measured) per second; Windows measured 0.0 (GetProcessIoCounters, all I/O including pipes); macOS exposes no per-process disk-operation counter

status.note: The status call returns rightkit_child_process::ProcessUsage (resident and footprint bytes, cumulative CPU seconds, wake-up and disk-operation totals where the host reports them) beside the crate's own queue figures; the rates come from two calls (ProcessUsage::rates_since). Wake-ups are macOS only; disk operations are Windows and Linux only.

notes: Ceilings come from the recorded measurements by stated rules (ceilingSources). Memory profile: the ledger is held once in memory plus one encoded copy (the rollback source) that each save replaces; there is no per-mutation whole-ledger clone. The 0.1.1 evidence figures (728 MB macOS, 208 MB Windows for a 100,000-record zone) predate that change; the per-pass local item listing (LocalStore::all) is the remaining O(records) term.
